title: docs(ie11): Fix rendering on IE11
body:
`active` class was defined twice and was breaking IE11 strict mode.

Also, it is needed to encode the `<` in the `document.write` hack otherwise the parser gets confused.

comments.body: By doing so, the script/style will be loaded after all the other pending requests. This is not big deal for CSS, but will break JS. So I used the same method for both types, because it was easier.
